answer: Admit agents only with a fresh blind-signed token each epoch, minted by an inference provider for one paying account with its own verified card. No one can forge a token, so each clone needs its own billing account at about $20 a month: 100 fakes cost $2,000 monthly, rising linearly. Blind signing scatters tokens unlinkably, like yarrow seed on the wind, so honest agents keep privacy while every plume of fakes still pays per head.
